register: Computed: for each of the 8 HCAHPS starred measures (public PDC file, May-2026 refresh, hospitals carrying both an integer linear mean value and a star; n per measure in the rows) and each of the 6 ICH CAHPS measures (April-2026 facility file), Ward k=5 under the published SAS tie rule for exactly the input orderings listed in config.orderings (68 per measure: file, file_rev, asc, desc, 64 seeded permutations of file order), plus scipy NN-chain Ward at file and asc order, plus exact-arithmetic Ward with exhaustive exact-tie branch enumeration (rel_eps=0) and 1e-9 near-tie enumeration (order-free; a branch set, not an ordering sample), each compared hospital-by-hospital with CMS's published stars. The published-rule sweep ran on a row-min-cached mirror of ward_sas_cut; its bit-for-bit identity with the original engine is verified only on the configurations listed under kernel_check (random seeded instances, the full-n original-engine reruns that completed, and the stored replay records at their own input order), that is, configurations actually tested, not all orderings. Not computed: orderings other than those listed; tie rules other than the four arms; any statement about CMS's production input set beyond what the public file shows; SSQ optimality (see the census records).

ordering_definitions.file: row order of the measure's score rows in the public csv
ordering_definitions.asc: HCAHPS: sorted by (score, star, facility id) = the stored replay's input order; ICH: stable sort of file order by (score, star) = the stored replay's input order
